monotonic_task.meaning: Latest captured read returned from read_seqcount_begin; no stage3 or matching captured function exit. The capture function itself may have been preempted before returning.

timer_callback.instruction: mrs x1,sp_el0, immediately after msr daif,x1 and before preempt-count decrement
timer_callback.interrupted_task_pid: NOT_CAPTURED; do not assume PID1 or recorder context

interpretation_limits: Last completed timer callback does not prove IRQ-exit/softirq/scheduling completed.
Unfinished task clock capture can mean descheduling, not a clock-core fault.
Previous task counter value is not the unfinished task clock call sample.
A single latest capture does not establish duration, permanent stagnation or root cause.
